name: NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce
author: Salauddin Ahmed Bhuiyan

sections.description:
NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce is a first-party WooCommerce business intelligence and analytics platform designed to help store owners understand store performance, customer behavior, products, acquisition and conversion activity from within WordPress.

The plugin turns WooCommerce store data and optional first-party analytics events into practical reporting across commerce, customers, marketing, behavior, conversion and performance.

The plugin works with WooCommerce data and stores its analytics data in the site’s WordPress database. Analytics tracking is optional and requires explicit visitor consent when enabled.

Features

  • Executive and business intelligence dashboards with KPI and trend reporting.
  • WooCommerce revenue, orders, average order value, products, customers and payment-method analytics.
  • Conversion funnel and checkout intelligence with observed checkout and payment signals.
  • Customer Intelligence with repeat behavior, purchase intervals, category preference and explainable customer health signals.
  • Customer Journey and customer-level behavioral reporting.
  • Cohorts and retention analysis.
  • Customer Segments and RFM analysis.
  • Acquisition, campaigns, referrals and traffic-source reporting.
  • Marketing intelligence and attribution reporting.
  • Geography, devices, site search and behavior analytics.
  • Real-time event reporting with privacy-conscious first-party tracking.
  • True Profit reporting with recorded product and order costs, refunds, shipping and payment-related costs where available.
  • Goals, conversions and A/B testing reporting.
  • Performance and speed-readiness diagnostics for the WordPress and WooCommerce environment.
  • Local Business Copilot and rule-based business insights without requiring an external AI service.
  • WooCommerce-compatible floating cart controls and a WooCommerce-backed fallback drawer.
  • Export tools for report data in CSV, JSON and print/PDF workflows.

Dashboard

The main dashboard provides an overview of store performance in one place.

It includes:

  • Total sales.
  • Orders.
  • Average order value.
  • Conversion rate.
  • Sales trends.
  • Top products.
  • Product recommendations.
  • Customer behavior insights.
  • Abandoned cart recovery insights.
  • Recent orders.

Analytics

The Analytics module provides a broader view of website and store activity.

It includes reporting for:

  • Visitors.
  • Sessions.
  • Page views.
  • Bounce rate.
  • Average session duration.
  • Events.
  • Traffic channel breakdown.
  • Top pages.
  • Top products.
  • Device breakdown.
  • Store performance insights.

Product Intelligence

Product Intelligence focuses on product-level performance and conversion behavior.

It provides:

  • Total products.
  • Product views.
  • Add-to-cart activity.
  • Purchases.
  • Product revenue.
  • Product conversion rate.
  • Product views over time.
  • Top products by revenue.
  • Top-performing product tables.
  • Product performance by category.
  • Product insights.

Checkout Intelligence

Checkout Intelligence helps store owners understand checkout activity and identify drop-off points.

It provides reporting for:

  • Started checkout.
  • Reached checkout.
  • Completed orders.
  • Checkout conversion rate.
  • Checkout abandonment rate.
  • Checkout funnel stages.
  • Abandonment by checkout step.
  • Abandonment reasons where survey data is available.
  • Checkout performance over time.
  • Checkout optimization reporting.
  • Checkout insights.

Customer Journey

Customer Journey provides reporting about how customers interact with the store across multiple stages.

It can show:

  • Total customers.
  • Journey starts.
  • Products viewed.
  • Add-to-cart activity.
  • Orders.
  • Journey conversion rate.
  • Customer journey flow.
  • Common journey paths.
  • Entry pages.
  • Journey health.
  • Journey performance by device.
  • Customer journey insights.
  • Cohort-based journey timelines.

Site Search

Site Search provides reporting for searches performed on the store.

It includes:

  • Total searches.
  • Total clicks.
  • Click-through rate.
  • Searches with no results.
  • Top search terms.
  • Search volume.
  • Search clicks.
  • Search click-through rate.
  • No-result counts.
  • Search performance reporting.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later.
  • WooCommerce is required.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.

Usage

After activation, open NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce in wp-admin to access the available intelligence modules.

Reports use the store’s WooCommerce data and the plugin’s first-party analytics events where consent has been provided.

NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce uses WooCommerce as the source of truth for cart and order data. The floating cart interface can use the active theme/WooCommerce cart drawer when available and provides a WooCommerce-backed fallback when a compatible native drawer opener cannot be detected.

Privacy

Analytics is optional and disabled by default.

When analytics is enabled, NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce asks visitors for explicit analytics consent before creating its analytics visitor cookie or recording analytics events.

Analytics data is stored in the site’s WordPress database. The plugin does not send analytics data to an external analytics or AI server. The plugin does not require registration with an external analytics service.

Analytics events may include event type, product or order identifiers, pseudonymous visitor/session identifiers, device information, event value, page information and timestamps, depending on the enabled tracking features.

The plugin provides WordPress personal-data export and erasure callbacks for analytics data associated with registered WordPress users or their WooCommerce billing email where available.

For site owners, WordPress privacy tools can be used to review and manage personal data stored by the site.

Data Retention and Uninstall

NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce stores its analytics data in plugin-owned WordPress database tables.

Deactivating the plugin does not delete stored analytics data.

Uninstalling the plugin removes its plugin-owned analytics tables and plugin settings.

External Services

NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce does not require or use an external analytics, tracking or AI service to provide its core functionality.

The plugin’s analytics and intelligence processing are performed locally on the WordPress site.

The plugin documentation references the GNU General Public License URL:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html

Source Code

All JavaScript and CSS distributed with NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce are shipped in human-readable source form within the plugin package.

In particular, the administrative JavaScript source is available at assets/admin-review.js, and the readable CSS sources are available in assets/.

No compiled or minified source is required to run the distributed plugin.

Development and source-file details are documented in docs/SOURCE-CODE.md.

Quick Links

GitHub: https://github.com/Salauddin-Ahmed
linkin : https://www.linkedin.com/in/salauddin-ahmed-bhuiyan/

Support

For support, use the WordPress.org support forum for NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce after the plugin is published.

When reporting an issue, include:

  • WordPress version.
  • WooCommerce version.
  • PHP version.
  • A description of the affected module or admin page.
  • Any relevant error message or reproduction steps.

Notes

NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce uses the active theme/WooCommerce cart as the primary cart UI. It automatically detects common native mini-cart/drawer toggles for popular themes and WooCommerce cart interfaces. If no usable native drawer opener is found, NexaFlow Intelligence opens its own WooCommerce-backed fallback drawer. The fallback drawer does not maintain a separate cart; WooCommerce remains the source of truth.

Analytics are optional and disabled by default. When enabled, NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce asks visitors for explicit analytics consent before creating its analytics visitor cookie or recording analytics events. Analytics data is stored in the local WordPress database and is not sent to an external server by the plugin. The plugin does not include third-party tracking or remote analytics services. Analytics events may include event type, product/order IDs, pseudonymous visitor/session IDs, device type, event value and timestamp.

License

NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce is licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce ZIP file.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce in the WordPress admin and configure the available settings.
  6. If analytics is enabled, configure the consent experience before collecting analytics events.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Added functional report exports for CSV, JSON and print/PDF workflows.
  • Hardened analytics, customer intelligence, cohort, RFM, geography and conversion reporting for larger WooCommerce stores.
  • Added performance-safe customer analytics processing and aggregation.
  • Hardened admin output escaping, SQL preparation, input validation and database operations.
  • Added WooCommerce HPOS compatibility declaration.
  • Completed Plugin Check hardening with no errors or warnings in the final local check.
  • Refined privacy-conscious first-party analytics and consent handling.
  • Prepared the release documentation and metadata for WordPress.org submission.

1.0.4

  • WordPress personal-data export and erasure tools include events linked to a registered user or their WooCommerce billing email.
  • Uninstalling NexaFlow Intelligence for WooCommerce removes the plugin’s analytics table and settings.
  • Fixed the Commerce > Customers page critical error.
  • Reworked customer reporting to use bounded WooCommerce order batches.
  • Removed per-customer lifetime order queries that could exhaust memory or execution time on larger stores.
  • Kept the Customers report compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and standard WooCommerce order APIs.

1.0.5

  • Renamed the public product brand to NexaFlow Intelligence.
  • Added the positioning tagline: The WooCommerce Business Growth & Intelligence Platform.
  • Added the marketing message: Turn WooCommerce Data Into Business Growth.
  • Updated the plugin text domain and public brand assets for the final pre-submission build.
  • Analytics tracking is opt-in and requires an explicit visitor choice when analytics is enabled.
  • Analytics data is stored in the site’s WordPress database.
  • Removed hardcoded/demo-like analytics visual values and replaced them with live store data or explicit empty states.
  • Replaced synthetic customer-growth bars with real customer-period data.
  • Replaced fixed traffic, continent, device and funnel donut percentages with calculated live values.
  • Removed static geography map dots that did not represent tracked locations.
  • Replaced the settings preview’s fixed cart count/total with the current WooCommerce cart when available.
  • Corrected product metric labeling from misleading growth to actual sales-to-adds conversion.

1.0.6

  • fixed Audience 3 Pages
